name: Damian Mack
life: “I still remember using a relative's first name in an awkward school form.” People around the blocks below Foundry Lofts know Damian by a small Sunday habit. Damian checks the little hand-lettered notices around Harbour Supply.
voice: I am the one who insisted we call him by his first name. At the station dad came out anyway.
appearance: On an ordinary day, look for a brown corduroy jacket and a fabric zip pull cut from a school scarf. Damian has a crooked front tooth visible when laughing, with close-cropped dark curls. Damian turns fully toward the person speaking during a conversation.
personality: Damian always notices who paid for the last round. In a group that can be a kindness or a small tyranny, and Damian is trying to tell the difference before the bill arrives.
agenda: To choose a family name freely in the father's presence.
family: Chris Dunn is Damian’s half-sibling. Damian asks the question the rest of the family avoided. Chris chooses an ordinary story to tell. They tend to get further with an important subject when it arrives in the middle of talk about dinner or work. Asked about *Saturday keys*, Chris says, “I borrowed the ring to water geraniums. I should have told the driver the flowers belonged to my late girlfriend.”
connections: Lina Farrell. The second branch of the family has a different name for the man everybody is trying to greet.

reactions.response: Damian leaves the departing sibling room to get out without turning supper into a vote.

reactions.response: Damian asks who can manage the stairs and who would rather wait by the landing, without attempting a move on their behalf.
